messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 P2 alert — Dedicated pool: tenant heartbeat silence detected for tenant t-84A7. Observability gaps: traces not ingesting, logs intermittent, metrics partition skew. Trigger: p95 latency spike + no KV cache heartbeats. Please ack and triage.

jamie (oncall): acked. seeing missing spans in tracing for t-84A7 since ~2750012200. Logs show repeated 504s from forwarder. paging oncall list.

arjun (eng-runtime): looking. initial hunch: dedicated forwarder agent lost auth token after rotation; fallback route failed. can someone paste the forwarder logs?

jamie (oncall): pasted snippet below from forwarder-84a7 (tail -n 50):
```
2026-03-15T12:03:05Z forwarder[pid=1245] ERROR upstream=proxy.redwood.io status=504 msg="upstream timeout" tenant=t-84A7
2026-03-15T12:03:06Z forwarder[pid=1245] WARN reconnecting attempt=1
2026-03-15T12:03:09Z forwarder[pid=1245] ERROR auth=kv token=expired tenant=t-84A7
2026-03-15T12:03:10Z forwarder[pid=1245] ERROR failed to publish span batch size=0 tenant=t-84A7
```

jamie (oncall): trace ingestion pipeline shows no spans past that time. metrics backend has partial shards but traces are silent. customer-visible: their APM graphs flatline for recent requests => might impact error-alerting and SLO dashboards.

morgan (next-oncall): i'm pulling the runbook: docs/runbooks/dedicated-forwarder-token-rotation. looks like rotation completed at 12:02 but agent didn't pick up new token. quick check: `kubectl -n dedicated get secret forwarder-t-84a7 -o yaml` shows rotated secret present. agent logs show token validation error.

arjun (eng-runtime): if secret exists but agent didn't reload, could be sidecar not restarting. propose quick mitigation: restart forwarder pod for tenant t-84A7 to pick up new secret. will coord with oncall.

jamie (oncall): rolling restart now on dedicated cluster pool-22: `kubectl -n dedicated rollout restart daemonset/forwarder-tenant-84a7` — exec output: restarting pods 3/3.

ops-bot: deploy-bot triggered restart job id=deploy-8843, status=IN_PROGRESS.

arjun (eng-runtime): after restart, please tail logs for successful auth handshake. looking for `auth=kv token=valid` and `upstream connected`.

jamie (oncall): logs after restart:
```
2026-03-15T12:07:12Z forwarder[pid=2134] INFO auth=kv token=valid tenant=t-84A7
2026-03-15T12:07:13Z forwarder[pid=2134] INFO upstream connected endpoint=proxy.redwood.io tenant=t-84A7
2026-03-15T12:07:14Z forwarder[pid=2134] INFO publishing span batch size=42 tenant=t-84A7
```

jamie (oncall): partial recovery: traces began flowing after restart. however metrics shard sync still showing ~30% of metric series missing (likely separate partitioning issue).

lina (cs): heads-up to CS: i'll notify the customer (security-sensitive enterprise) that trace ingestion resumed but some graphs may still be stale; ETA for full recovery?

arjun (eng-runtime): investigating metric partition skew. early sign: dedicated metrics forwarder lagged behind due to backlog and TTL trimming during the outage. mitigation options: 1) replay metrics from hot-s3 partition for tenant t-84A7 (expensive) 2) rehydrate short window (last 10m) for dashboards only 3) keep dashboards annotated as partial. my recommendation: replay small window for customer KPIs (10m).

morgan (next-oncall): agree with targeted replay. pls open a controlled replay job and throttled so it doesn't overload shards. can we do a dry-run?

arjun (eng-runtime): creating replay job: `replay-job create --tenant t-84A7 --from 2750012000 --to 2750012400 --throttle 500/s --dry-run false` — job id=rp-9921. starting now.

ops-bot: replay job rp-9921 queued on metrics-cluster-3. estimated run 6m.

jamie (oncall): customer impact note for CS: traces returned at 12:07 UTC; dashboards may be incomplete until replay finishes (~12:13). recommending message: "We restored trace ingestion; our team is replaying metric data for the affected time window to restore dashboards. No model inference correctness impact reported; only observability." Lina to send.

lina (cs): sending to customer now (redacted): "We've restored trace flow and are replaying metrics to populate the missing window. Expect dashboards updated within ~10 minutes. No data loss of raw logs — logs are archived and we can surface them if needed. We'll follow up with a post-incident summary."

arjun (eng-runtime): replay job progress: 20% -> 60% -> 100%. ops-bot: rp-9921 completed successfully, items processed=18,420, peak rps=480.

jamie (oncall): verification: traces showing continuous spans, dashboards reflect KPIs again. metrics partition balance normalizing. marking impact: partial observability for ~5m window, traces resumed with restart.

morgan (next-oncall): handoff note: i'll take next-oncall shift and monitor for 1h for any reoccurrence. created follow-up ticket ENG-RUN-1273 to harden forwarder token reload path and to add automated rolling restart when secret changes.

arjun (eng-runtime): adding action item to add liveness probe and token-watch sidecar; will PR today.

jamie (oncall): closing thread from oncall side. final customer status: informed, metrics replay complete, no data loss reported. recommend postmortem and add tenant-level observability checks to alerting (e.g., trace-silence alarm per-tenant).

ops-bot: incident-bot closing alert. incident severity downgraded to RESOLVED at 2750012660 UTC.

morgan (next-oncall): tagging owners: @arjun FYI for ENG-RUN-1273, @lina please attach customer message to ticket. thanks all :wave:
